title: nasturtium indicum
intro: Nasturtium indicum, commonly known as Indian cress, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Indian cress include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support digestive health, making it a valuable herbal remedy. Bioactive constituents of Nasturtium indicum include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
